about: The Main Gate's evening and night (from sitting 18), written early by hand on 11 Oct 2026 at the owner's word, "Lets go with the next batch then": the last chosen yard without its hours. Relit from the chosen gate (O36), fitted, in the scratch root, by the tool's own outdoor relight prompt with the sentences below, from tools/art/staged/early/campus_for_batch3.json.

Its night follows O40, O44 and 5.7a: a full moon, round and whole; every window dark (nobody is up in the schoolhouse or the hall); the garden's stone lamps give a small warm glow, as the Courtyard's and the Dormitory Garden's do; nothing added. The prompt check refuses the word 'lantern' for the gate, so they are 'stone lamps'.
The two sentences go into tools/art/batches.json once the art tools' tests now running have finished.

sentences.gate_evening: Change the time of day to early evening: a warm orange and pink sunset sky, and low golden sunlight from the left with long soft shadows falling to the right; the still water reflects the evening sky. Everything in the picture and on the hills is still there. Add no new light.
sentences.gate_night: Change the time of day to night: a deep blue night sky with stars and a full moon, round and whole, and cool blue moonlight on everything, with soft shadows; the still water reflects the night sky. Every window of the buildings is dark. The stone lamps standing in the garden give a small warm glow; add no other light. Everything in the picture and on the hills is still there, as dark shapes against the sky. Add no bench, sign, lamp or light that is not in the picture now.

rows.label: Main Gate, night, every window dark
